decision: held: full text of both declared sources (36719452 Arch Gynecol Obstet 2023; 10334745 BMJ 1999) was not retrievable in this session (no open full text; PMC page behind a browser check), so doses, dosage forms and included trials cannot be verified; record also has no health_goals_supported to match outcomes against
summary: Abstracts only: the 2023 NVP meta-analysis (18 studies) pooled pyridoxine alone with pyridoxine-plus-other-agent arms (Rhodes score SMD 0.78, PUQE 0.75) without doses in the abstract; the 1999 BMJ PMS review (9 trials, 940 women, OR 2.32 overall) states most trials were low quality and mentions doses 'up to 100 mg/day' only in general terms. Neither can be fully verified without full text, and Dr. Pham's A118 source-content hold stays. No contexts were authored.
